{{Quote|Our sensors would have detected them first, Governor. We should rely on something other than a shaak's disposition.|Officer Chrin, to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]]|<ref name="TCWTV" />}}
'''Chrin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served as a member of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:Chrin_launcher.png|thumb|left|180px|Chrin firing a missile launcher]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Chrin was one of the two [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RNSF]] [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guards]] selected by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]] to investigate reports of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He voiced suspicion of the reports, which came from [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Shaak/Legends|shaak]] herder [[Peppi Bow/Legends|Peppi Bow]]. He was chided by Typho when the reports turned out to be true, and subsequently helped his captain to scout out and destroy a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] patrol with a [[RPS-6 rocket launcher/Legends|RPS-6]] [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]].<ref name="TCWTV" />

Chrin and Typho recovered the remains of the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] and [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], and returned to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] with them to ascertain the purpose for their presence on the peaceful [[Planet/Legends|world]] that had, as yet, remained untouched by the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCWTV" />
